build_resnet50_backbone: build a ResNet-50 backbone model using the Bottleneck block with default layer configuration
create_wide_resnet: create a ResNet-50 model with widened channels by setting widen=2 or widen=4
build_deep_resnet: build a ResNet-101, ResNet-151, or ResNet-200 model with deeper layer configurations
test_resnet_forward: test the ResNet forward pass with multi-crop inputs and return_before_head flag
review_bottleneck_block: review the Bottleneck class with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv pattern and expansion factor of 4
